notes: This portable C++ TCK slice composes two adapter-supplied FOM modules and the standard MIM. A joined target actively subscribes to one HLAbyte attribute in each of two distinct object classes. A subject registers two instances per class and sends six receive-order updates, including repeated updates to one instance of each class. The target verifies all four discoveries and all six standard reflect callbacks. A distinct joined requester asks for the target's HLAreportObjectInstancesReflected and decodes the standard class-based counts, requiring exactly two instances for each tested class. The count records use standard HLAinteger32BE, HLAoctet, HLAfixedRecord, and HLAvariableArray elements with the public object-class handle decoder. Provider package, FOM modules, application class and attribute names, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation are adapter inputs. The test invokes no region or other DDM services, uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs and the C++ standard library, and contains no private headers, provider registry access, or vendor-specific names.
